description: This file is a comprehensive documentation (likely Markdown) describing the design, functionality, interfaces, and system context of the Composite Input HAL interface for a platform. It provides detailed specifications about capabilities, discovery, event handling, properties, state machines, and platform integration related to composite video input ports, used mainly for legacy analog video support within a larger system.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Defines the capabilities of a composite input port, including supported properties, metrics, and signal statuses.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of a port, including connection state, signal status, and video mode.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enumerates possible signal states such as NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, and NOT_SUPPORTED.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Provides details about the video resolution and format detected on a port.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: A key-value pair used for batch property queries and settings, encapsulating property keys and their values.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Metadata describing properties, including data type, read/write permissions, and description.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Retrieve the list of available port IDs for enumeration.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieve the capabilities of a port, including supported properties and metrics.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Obtain platform-wide capabilities and feature flags.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Get an interface to a specific port by ID.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Query a specific property value from a port.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieve telemetry metrics from a port if supported.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activate or deactivate a port for video presentation.

methods.name: registerTelemetryListener
methods.description: Register for periodic telemetry updates from a port.

methods.name: resetMetrics
methods.description: Reset telemetry counters on a port.
